description: A three-repo example fleet. Placeholder names only.
_note: Annotation keys start with an underscore and are never warned about.

dependsOn._note: Package-level edges; default topological order for campaigns.

ownership._note: A discovered dependency is filed in the owning repo.

policy.customRule: relayed verbatim to every worker; never interpreted by the kit

depOverride.localStage: path override to a sibling worktree; must never reach a commit
depOverride.pushedStage: committed dependency pinned to a pushed SHA; downstream MR stays DRAFT

multiCampaign._machineGateSlots_note: A fallback; the machine config's machine.gate_slots wins.

stacking.sameRepo: sequential branches, each cut from its parent; DRAFT while upstream unmerged
stacking.crossRepo: independent branches from the default branch, linked via depOverride
